about: Stoked Surf School is on Beach Road in Perranporth and teaches on Perranporth Beach. Lessons run from first-timers to more experienced surfers, with progress tracked through The Loop, its own seven-level ability system. It also hires out boards and wetsuits daily on the beach.
where: 7 Beach Road, Perranporth TR6 0JL; lessons on Perranporth Beach
goodToKnow: Listed as a Surfing England surf school
season: Seven days a week through the season
gaps: Lesson inclusions, what to bring, kids' ages and cancellation terms were not stated.
